messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: pre-release of poppr version 2.8
parts:
Hello,

At the end of the week, I will be submitting poppr version 2.8.0 to CRAN. If you want to test it, you can install it from github using the remotes package:

remotes::install_github("grunwaldlab/po...@v.2.8.0rc")

If you have any questions or issues, please reply to this thread.

---------

Briefly, this version will contain some long-awaited features and a few bug-fixes.

 - bitwise.dist() now can calculate Euclidean distance for genlight objects in a fraction of the time and memory of base R's dist() (see attached image).

 - AMOVA is now possible on genlight objects

 - The algorithm for placing the windows in win.ia() is now more consistent and also contains an option that will name the windows for easier referencing.

 - The mlg vignette has been updated to include a section on how to use cutoff_predictor() 

More details can be found in the NEWS document: https://github.com/grunwaldlab/poppr/blob/master/NEWS
